title: Proposal to Raise FDI Cap in Public Sector Banks to 49%
summary: Government considers raising FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) limit in PSBs from 20% to 49% while retaining minimum 51% state ownership.

blocks.title: 📰 5. 🤝 MoUs, CONFERENCES & APPOINTMENTS
blocks.text: 🪝 Proposal to Raise FDI Cap in Public Sector Banks to 49%. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Inter-ministerial discussions are underway to **raise the FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) ceiling in Public Sector Banks from 20% to 49%** (govt must retain ≥51% stake) to build 3–4 globally-scaled Indian banks.
**Private Banks Comparison**: Private banks allow up to 74% FDI (single foreign institution capped at 15%).
**Highest PSB Foreign Holding**: SBI (11.07%) > Canara Bank (10.55%) > Bank of Baroda (9.43%).
